stem: A nurse leader is managing a team whose members differ in age, background, and work experience. Which approach best supports effective teamwork?

options.A: Assign fixed communication styles based on each employee's generation.
options.B: Promote mutual respect and support across different backgrounds and use team diversity as an asset rather than relying on generational stereotypes.
options.C: Avoid collaboration between age groups to prevent conflict.
options.D: Assume workers of the same age share identical values and learning preferences.

rationale: AHRQ TeamSTEPPS emphasizes mutual support, respect, communication, and the effective use of diverse team members. Predicting behavior from generational stereotypes is not a reliable teamwork strategy.
educational_objective: Use respectful, nonstereotyped teamwork practices with a multigenerational clinical team.
source_organization: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ)
source_locator: Emerging Team Challenges — workforce/team diversity; mutual respect and support
source_claim_supported: Effective teams support mutual respect across differing backgrounds rather than assigning predictable preferences by generation.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Management of Care, printed p.7/PDF p.11
blueprint_topic: Management of Care — team leadership and collaboration
correction_summary: Removed unsupported generational stereotypes and reframed the item around TeamSTEPPS respect, support, and team diversity.
